title: Cone classes of triangulated subcategories admit localization
statement: Let $\mathcal T$ be a triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category] and $\mathcal S$ a full replete triangulated subcategory, containing zero and closed under shifts and distinguished triangles. Let $W$ consist of morphisms $u:X\to Y$ for which there is a distinguished triangle $X\xrightarrow{u}Y\to Z\to X[1]$ with $Z\in\mathcal S$. Then $W$ contains identities, is closed under composition, admits both left and right calculi of fractions, and is compatible with the triangulated structure: it is invariant under shifts, and a commuting square on the first two objects of distinguished triangles whose two vertical maps lie in $W$ extends to a morphism of triangles whose third map also lies in $W$. No closure of $\mathcal S$ under direct summands is required, and no saturation assertion is made.

source.place: Tag 05RG (lemma-construct-multiplicative-system), first assertion: the cone class of a full triangulated subcategory is a multiplicative system compatible with the triangulation. Tag 05RL (lemma-operations) concerns saturation instead. The Mathlib trW instances give precisely the nonsaturation statement here.
